Valerianae radix - Valerian root

Therapeutic indications

Well-established use: Relief of mild nervous tension and sleep disorders.

Traditional use: Used traditionally to aid sleep and to relieve mild symptoms of mental stress; relief of mild spasmodic gastrointestinal complaints.

Contraindications

Hypersensitivity to the active substance; Children under 12 years of age (well-established use) or under 4 years (traditional use).

Pharmaceutical form

Herbal tea; Dry extract (drug-extract ratio 3-7.4:1); Tincture (1:5 ethanol 70%); Expressed juice from fresh root.
